## ICCV 2023 BERT video-and-text no-GPT test cohort

<a id="intentqa-iccv2023-no-gpt-test"></a>

**Task:** `intention_reasoning` (original: context-aware video intent reasoning)  
**Dataset release:** `v1` �� **Annotation version:** `author-release-unspecified`  
**Target:** `intent_qa` �� **Split:** Original paper test split

### Comparison setting

| Dimension | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sample selection | Original IntentQA test split: VGT with BERT text representation from Table 2 and four cumulative context-model ablations from Table 3; GPT-assisted and text-only rows excluded. |
| Inputs | rgb, text; Full question and video clip at inference; no external GPT answer stage. |
| Representation | Video frame/region features derived from RGB and BERT question-answer representation; model-internal feature fusion varies. |
| Observation window | variable seconds (Clip length varies by example; complete supplied clip is observed.) |
| Anticipation gap | not applicable |
| Prediction horizon | not applicable |
| Training policy | external_data: forbidden, pretraining: allowed, extra_supervision: allowed, ensemble: forbidden |
| Evaluation | Five-choice IntentQA answer classification; VGT BERT row in Table 2 and no-GPT model variants in Table 3.; Overall test accuracy. |
